prompt:
Draft a short, kind letter from the Harbour Hill School admissions office to a parent.
Parent: Aoife O'Rourke. Child: Finn O'Rourke. Application: HH-0114.
Say we need a person on our team to check these things before we can go on: the child lives at two addresses (clause 5.2). Ask the parent to reply from the email address on the form.
Do not promise a place. Do not say a computer or AI made any decision. Sign it from the Admissions Officer.
Use short sentences and plain words.
source: written for the course; replace with live replies using bun run record

replies.text:
Dear Aoife O'Rourke,

Thank you for your application for Finn (HH-0114).
Before we can go on, a member of our team needs to check a few things: the child lives at two addresses (clause 5.2). We will contact you. Please reply only from the email address on your form.
We have not made any decision yet. A person on our team makes every decision.

Yours sincerely,

Admissions Officer, Harbour Hill School
